provenance.what: The two generation specs for the v2 base/candidate comparison, staged through hpc3-stage rather than copied by hand
provenance.why: Two arms MUST differ in exactly one field or the comparison is confounded. These specs carry max_new_tokens, max_prompt_tokens, batch_size, repetition_penalty, seed, the holdout path and the adapter path; the only field that differs between them is `arm`. A digest per spec makes that checkable after the fact instead of re-read by eye.
provenance.arms: base and candidate name the SAME artifact_path deliberately -- model_trainer's _default_load_continuation_arm reattaches the adapter for `candidate` and loads the weights it was trained from for `base`, so sharing the path is what guarantees the base arm is the exact model the adapter came from
provenance.generated: jobs 55809956 (base, 6297s) and 55809960 (candidate, 8191s), both A30, from the adapter e675f88218fd
provenance.holdout: code-corpus-v2.holdout.jsonl, sha256 5c1697e2fe06..., referenced BY PATH from inside these specs rather than on the command line -- which is a gap the command-line input check cannot see and this record does not close
